documents.summary: University-wide guidance naming Microsoft Copilot as the approved platform, a four-tier data classification limiting what may be entered into AI tools, and prohibited uses (including no AI grading and no uploading student work). It leaves course rules to instructors with three sample syllabus tiers, and adds research guidance on authorship, disclosure and peer review.
documents.stance_why: The guidance sets data and platform rules for everyone but leaves classroom AI use to instructors: "Instructors have discretion over whether and how generative AI tools fit their course's learning outcomes", and it supplies three sample syllabus statements (prohibition, allowed with attribution, encouragement) as "a starting point", so the stance is delegates with tiers.
